mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25% over 3 months are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPI) and federal funds rate above their 3-month moving averages signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increase > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS increase > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the joint condition is met in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production growth (relative to the previous quarter) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods of rising HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below -0.5% month-over-month signals weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls above 50k and a decline in unemployment rate below 0.1 percentage points signals a rapidly tightening labor market, prompting aggressive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the joint condition is met in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-inflation shock regime (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-inflation shock regime, S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises.
